text:
maya: quick design thought — the priority rail is getting unwieldy when policies hit 8+ rules. scrolling + big cards makes scanning slow. thoughts on adding a compact "dense" view toggle? :thinking:

samir: +1. main friction is card chrome (padding, shadow). if dense reduces padding, flattens shadow, and hides secondary meta it should speed scanning. but we need to keep affordances for drag & keyboard.

olivia: dense toggle sounds good. suggestion: collapse long descriptions and replace them with an inline icon row for key attributes (region, model, allow/deny, rate-limit). hover expands details. that preserves info while staying compact.

maya: love the icon row. another issue: drag handle size for keyboard users is tiny. propose a persistent "reorder mode" (button) that reveals bigger move controls (up/down chevrons) and locks other interactions to avoid accidental drags.

jess: accessibility: when moving via keyboard we must announce moves with aria-live like "Moved rule 'Block PII' to position 2". current preview doesn't announce anything. also focus needs to remain on the moved item after the operation.

samir: noted. also simulator validation bug: if two rules share identical priority and have contradictory actions, preview shows both branches but there's no inline warning next to the rules — only a global toast after simulation finishes. that's easy to miss.

olivia: inline is better UX. propose a small warning pill under the rule title: "priority clash" with an info tooltip linking to fallback semantics and suggested fixes. keep pills low-visual-weight (outline or subtle bg).

maya: mock idea: in the preview timeline add a slim heatmap strip that visualizes how often each rule fires across the simulated sample. hover reveals counts; footer has a tiny legend. helps confirm which rules are effectively active.

jess: heatmap is neat. design note: color contrast must be >=3:1 for low-vision users and provide text fallback (hover counts) so color isn't the only signal. aria description for the strip should summarize top N rules.

deploy-bot: preview-sim: deployed heatmap strip to staging. run `preview-sim --policy 42 --samples 500` to refresh. logs: /staging/sim/42.

samir: follow-ups: olivia will iterate on dense toggle + icon row + warning pill in Figma, jess will draft aria-live announcements and focus behavior, maya will write inline warning copy and heatmap tooltip text. i'll capture these in the spec doc and add a small acceptance checklist. :thumbsup:

olivia: aiming to drop mocks by EOD Friday.

maya: thanks all!
